description: DUT receives an MSS option in a SYN and clamps the effective send segment size to min(advertised, DUT_MSS) (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.6 p85). Iterations: Mv=200 (smaller), Mv=2000 (larger)
approach:
[Objective]
The two-sided MSS contract: each peer advertises its own receive MSS; the sender uses the smaller of (peer's advertised, my own MTU-based max). Phase 1: peer advertises 200 (smaller than DUT's 1460) → DUT sends ≤200. Phase 2: peer advertises 2000 (larger) → DUT sends DUT_MSS = 1460.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases. For each: tester opens connection advertising MSS Mv; DUT (UT-driven) sends data; tester observes data segment size on the wire.

[Pass condition]
Phase 1 segment size ≤ 200; phase 2 segment size = DUT_MSS (1460).

[Fail condition]
Per phase: Fail_wrong_size_phase<n> or Fail_timeout_phase<n>.

verdicts.Pass: DUT clamped send size to min(adv, DUT_MSS) — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_size_phase1: Phase 1 segment size not advertised MSS 200
verdicts.Fail_wrong_size_phase2: Phase 2 segment size not DUT MSS 1460
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase1: No DUT data segment phase 1 Mv=200
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase2: No DUT data segment phase 2 Mv=2000
